bars.says: On a full Stillsand map the player sees exposed corrugated ochre sand separating rock destinations, with sparse living cover, physical bone landmarks and wreckage under a fixed sun.

meant.intent: Without open exposed travel, the selected desert and discovery emphasis are lost; an ordinary lush or crowded biome would be refused.
meant.source: OWNER:1794377002766121379 (fortunes through emptiness); delegated from Biomes.compose.json Stillsand line, root.md and current BiomeDef for the land picture.

accept: Across the map a traveller crosses exposed sand before reaching usable rock; low plants and occasional bones or wrecks punctuate the ground while leaving the route visibly open.
The sun remains in its tile-governed place while an ordinary sandstorm temporarily reduces visibility; weather does not turn fixed daylight into a normal night.
reject: A curated bare pad looks empty but beyond it vegetation, repeated wrecks or tightly packed destinations leave no exposed crossing.
Sand appears as little patches surrounded by lush ground, or corrugation is just a word over a flat featureless presentation.
bars.lazy: none: Open land, corrugation and how sparse cover reads are rendered relationships a count cannot certify; the rejected pad cannot satisfy the full-map separating-destinations wording.

range.varies: Whole supplied local maps: small/default/large (225/250/325 cells and actual largest intended map), plain/rockless-tor/rock-rich viable layouts; fresh and 100-day initial states; ordinary Clear, DryThunderstorm and Sandstorm intervals; inhabited and uninhabited, 1/6/40 colonists. Observe spatial regions (centre, edges, destination approaches) and full-map view, not a hand-picked station.
range.left_out: No planetary placement, tile counts or generated alternative worlds. No-cave layouts may occur but cannot excuse no useful destinations over the supplied region. Art variant counts and exact cover percentages are not acceptance.

bars.says: A traveller in Stillsand can shelter from Direct Sun under roofs, parasols and geometric cast shade, including a giant’s moving shadow, while ordinary air heat remains.

meant.intent: If a roof or parasol fails at low sun, or shelter cancels the actual hot air, the biome violates the standing Direct Sun rule and the prepared-refuge experience.
meant.source: Standing Direct Sun ruling, OWNER:1792410399049610407; delegated moving-shadow application from RM_Oommok ShadowCaster and adopted root.

accept: At the same air temperature the roofed traveller is protected from the direct component at low and high sun; an exposed traveller still receives it.
A giant moves; protection follows its current shadow and the old position becomes exposed unless another real caster still covers it.
reject: A roof works near overhead sun but fails at a low angle, or a hidden per-biome heat/glare floor keeps the roofed traveller exposed.
A painted shadow or the giant’s former position protects a traveller after the real caster has moved or died; shade makes the thermometer colder without an ordinary air-temperature cause.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence names real cover, motion and unchanged air heat; a false floor, static stamp or cold-air substitute cannot satisfy it.

Pawn bare/gear-covered, mobile/downed; compare before and after each shared grid refresh.
range.left_out: No separate biome sun/heat type, no time-driven sun motion on this fixed world, no indoor cooling guarantee. Tree-heavy other biomes and alternative planets are dependency scope, not new Stillsand promises.

accept: Small residents use depth, food or shade while giants move above them; normal foraging, catches, hunting, eggs or livestock products yield something the player can actually carry and use.
A shade follower changes shelter with its host, an ambush animal can feed and strike, and the flying resident enters a real flight state during its ordinary jobs.
reject: Actors spawn for a census but their ordinary jobs never find legal food or shelter, or their products have no usable acquisition path.
A claimed flyer walks through all ordinary movement; the tester counts its flight stat instead of any actual flight state.
bars.lazy: none: Actual AI jobs, hatching, feeding and flight tracker transitions need engine state; an offline def/role generator cannot prove their execution. The sentence requires ordinary lives, ruling out a spawn-only false pass.

accept: The connected mouth leads to a real chamber; after actual threats are removed the party can reach roofed rest and storage space through its secured approach.
A cave occupant returns or active drift covers the approach: the changed danger is real even though the cave was previously cleared.
reject: A letter announces a harbour but the carved mouth is blocked, the roof is only dark art or the chamber cannot be reached by the intended party.

A saved quest-cleared flag grants permanent safety in a reoccupied den or preservation despite a giant-size unowned wild animal on recorded cave cells; stepping on bare rock suppresses an attacker without a physical cause.

bars.says: The player can turn useful cave discoveries into supplies or equipment for the next expedition or outpost through ordinary collection, work or available trade, while removed cave contents stay removed on revisit and reload.

meant.intent: If discoveries have no usable provisioning or actual exchange route, or reappear when revisited, the practical-fortune answer and repeated-expedition signature fail. The owner makes lens production a possibility, so a separate solar workshop is unnecessary.
meant.source: OWNER:1794377002766121379, record.json s_practical_fortune (practical supplies, equipment or trade value, potentially useful lens production); delegated finite extraction and actual-use interpretation from the same answer and saved cave source.

accept: A cleared clutch supplies edible carried food, or cache food, components or steel are hauled and actually used to prepare the next undertaking; its emptied source stays empty on return.

Mined grotto biosilica is sold to an ordinary buyer that actually accepts it, and the proceeds buy usable provisions or equipment; lens manufacture is unnecessary. A taken cave or environmental seep can offer shelter without a material reward.
reject: A cave contains expensive-looking samples but no ordinary collection, usable work or actual exchange can turn any useful discovery into provisions or equipment.
A proof helper inserts completed provisions, a deferred workshop or event secretly supplies the only usable route, or reload puts the removed cache contents back.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires a discovery to reach actual usable supplies or equipment through available ordinary actions, and persistent removal; a trade flag, injected result or renewable display cannot satisfy it.

range.varies: Retained seep/guzzka/lens/cache/taken rows, useful, previously emptied and no-reward states; imported basic starting provisions versus scarce industrial inputs; exploration-before-storage/work preparation and preparation-before-exploration; native RM and supplying campaign; optional DBH present/absent with all DLC always. Parties/colonies of 1/6/40 sharing finite stocks, ordinary weather during extraction/hauling, job death/cancellation, full stockpile, save during extraction/transport/use and midway reload. Follow each kept useful discovery route to ordinary use or an actual accepting buyer and exchange; do not assume a trader arrives. Seep brine is environmental habitat, not promised expedition drinking water. Ordinary eggs/sacs retain their actual ingestion; no still output is needed.
range.left_out: No reward for every cave, fixed yield/profit/work rate, self-sufficient desert economy or guaranteed buyer visit. No furnace, lens bench, solar oven, still, dipping, fine-sand supplier, lens upgrade, corpse still, potion, pour or ritual required; all those special production routes are off.

meant.intent: Without readable movement and consequences, concealed desert life prevents useful travel decisions and violates the no-vanish ruling.
meant.source: Standing no-animal-or-pawn-vanishes-without-readable-sign ruling; delegated from shared sand-swim/wake/rumble/track and ordinary kill behaviour in the adopted sand-signs experience.

accept: During an actual submerged approach the traveller can see its disturbance and hear its rumble when audio is available; surfacing or a kill leaves an attributable visible body, trace or notice.
A drum lure can make an uncertain rumble and an old track can fade after ordinary sand movement; neither a sound nor silence claims an exact species or a safe route.
reject: An invisible predator makes contact with no advance visible sign; an incremented sound counter passes although the rumble cannot be heard at ordinary play settings.
A kill, dive or ordinary departure removes a pawn with no visible remains, trace or attributable notice, or stale tracks identify a departed creature as certainly present.
bars.lazy: none: Perceived visibility and audibility in the running mix cannot be certified by counters or offline timing. The sentence requires a visible pre-contact disturbance as well as available rumble and readable consequence, excluding silent body removal.

range.varies: All retained concealed movers and ambush approaches where their motion is possible: sand, deep drift, hard-ground transition, strike/damage/re-submerge/death/departure, quiet/windy/ordinary sandstorm, audio available/muted, distant/nearby source under each configured warning reach. bars.says: While no giant-size unowned wild animal holds a roofed cave, its eligible contents stay preserved in the recorded roofed cells, before and after exploration, and the player sees them return to ordinary decay when that protection is lost.

meant.intent: An old practical discovery/store that silently rots before use, or preservation leaking outside its actual space, defeats the scoped useful-cave promise; preserving other owners’ objects by overwriting their state would also be refused.
meant.source: delegated from useful old cave discovery, record.json cave_preservation and RM_CavePlace ownership/release; OWNER:1792759874733672738 retains cave preservation while cutting cave fluff; titan spoilage constrained by OWNER:1793738707492209767.

accept: Before first exploration and after discovery, an eligible object stays preserved in the recorded roofed cells while no giant-size unowned wild animal stands on any recorded cave cell, even if a smaller threat leaves the refuge unsecured; after the object is hauled or carried outside, or its roof is removed, ordinary decay and its readable status resume.

A stockpile crosses the cave edge: only contents actually in its protected recorded cells receive this feature’s effect; a live giant-size unowned wild animal standing on any recorded cave cell, including a harmless grazer, suspends the cave’s claim until it leaves, dies or becomes owned.
reject: Everything near the cave or in a straddling storage building stays fresh outdoors, or eligible contents in recorded roofed cells decay merely because exploration or physical securing has not occurred, despite no giant-size unowned wild animal standing on the cave cells.

Removing this feature turns another system’s already-disabled rot back on, reload forgets who owns a corpse timer, or a stale den-cleared flag preserves a cave reoccupied by a giant-size unowned wild animal.
bars.lazy: none: Recorded roofed space, current giant-size unowned wild-animal occupancy, preservation before and after exploration, and release to ordinary decay exclude a global freshness aura, security gate or quest bypass; calibrated owned-state transitions can distinguish the contract offline.

range.varies: M_STATES enumerates ordinary rot-capable item, ordinary animal corpse, titan-owned site/resource and nonrottable item; recorded inside/outside/edge cells, roof intact/lost/rebuilt, carried/stored/held parent, den live/dead/left/tamed/reoccupied, already disabled externally vs owned by cave, toggle off/on, reload before/after each transition and blocked placement. The existing BodySize >= 3 threshold is tracked in C_LAYOUT; a smaller threatening resident still prevents a secured refuge without suspending preservation. Sweep absent/harmless-giant/threatening-giant/small-threat occupants, inside/outside cave cells and below/at/above the size threshold.
range.left_out: No global outdoor no-rot, no titan-resource spoilage override or promise of preserving contents while a live giant-size unowned wild animal stands on a recorded cave cell, harmless grazers included. Corpses subject to another owner are not also converted by Stillsand.

bars.says: With the complete first version running through a season on a full Stillsand map, the player can repeat exposed crossings, secure and use a cave, and provision a further undertaking while the desert and its ordinary life persist through a midway reload and a changed order of the main actions.

meant.intent: If the complete retained system floods the map, empties its ordinary life, stalls its valid work or loses/duplicates consequences across ordinary continuation, isolated scenes do not deliver the owner’s expedition experience.
meant.source: delegated whole-mod requirement from this cleanse brief, grounded in OWNER:1794377002766121379 and the standing persistence/no-vanish/settings floor.

accept: Over the season the plain still separates destinations, living residents act normally, a secured refuge remains useful, and real spent/transformed supplies support another undertaking after reload.

Preparing storage and ordinary work before exploration and exploring before that preparation both preserve the discoveries and costs actually earned; revisiting or reloading never rerolls removed cave contents.
reject: The season becomes a carpet of life or debris, an unexplained fountain of provisions, or a lifeless cast with no practical discovery route while isolated pads still pass.
Weather or another retained mechanic is locked off to keep jobs moving; valid work never resumes, the midway reload loses or duplicates consequences, or repeated exceptions drown ordinary play.
bars.lazy: none: Only the full engine run and rendered map can settle the complete player experience; calibrated reduced models diagnose and choose informative intervals but cannot certify ordinary jobs, AI or visual persistence. The explicit repeat/reload/order/stretch excludes a finished static showcase.

range.varies: Full supplied local-map layouts and low/central/high legal dayside geometry, over the complete range of viable rock-cave and viable rockless-tor layouts; do not select a showcase pad or choose only an easy bearing. Unsuitable no-cave layouts are explicit negative controls in B_REFUGE/M_LAYOUT and do not certify this cave-use whole bar. Fresh and 100-day-aged initial states; 1/6/40-colonist active colonies; native RM and campaign supplying composition, optional egg/sac thirst-provider boundary. Runtime 15 game days (one season), save at an active intermediate point (not a finished showcase), no-reload sibling, and a second ordinary-action order: explore/secure/extract/ordinary work/use vs storage and ordinary work preparation/explore/secure/extract/use. Include ordinary storm during extraction/hauling/ordinary work and drift/giant movement during route use. If no storm occurs naturally, replay an explicitly labelled ordinary-weather history for interaction evidence without claiming frequency. No forced extra event is needed. No time skipping that bypasses ticks, food, work, growth, AI, weather, reservations or saves; faster scheduling of unchanged ticks is allowed.
range.left_out: No expectation that every random species or cave row appears naturally in a season; B_LIFE/B_SUPPLY read those declared ranges separately. No infinite self-sufficiency, no new planets, no next-version content, no magical refuge against later attack. A no-cave layout must be accounted for in the regional route rather than inventing a cave. Unsuitable no-cave local layouts cannot run the cave-use undertaking and are outside this bar; M_LAYOUT/M_SEASON must still establish that the supplied region has viable destinations rather than hiding a regional absence behind this exclusion.

sees.instrument: Runtime season with ordinary actions/state checkpoints and short representative looks, guided by calibrated M_SEASON/M_STATES/M_LAYOUT/M_SUPPLY and T_OBSERVER; no existing Clear-locked validation chain certifies it.

Record any controlled history/imports. Place save halfway through active cave/work/route consequences.

sees.control: Compare no-reload and reloaded sibling identity/accounting checkpoints, then reorder main actions without injected outputs or new cache draws. Trace all input/reward sources and weather/depth/caster states so ambient transport, imported supplies or held AI cannot impersonate the retained system. A flood, desert, stall and error storm are discriminated as in M_SEASON, using actual histories and whole-map looks.
sees.reset: Discard the disposable fixture and its sibling saves; restore the exact entry settings and external test configuration from a recorded snapshot, not old shipped defaults. No owner/canonical save is changed. Verify remaining reservations, held pawns, scheduled events and spawned identities against entry state.
sees.live_only_why: Only the full engine run and rendered map can settle the complete player experience; calibrated reduced models diagnose and choose informative intervals but cannot certify ordinary jobs, AI or visual persistence. The explicit repeat/reload/order/stretch excludes a finished static showcase.

tests.reject: delegated: If the complete retained system floods the map, empties its ordinary life, stalls its valid work or loses/duplicates consequences across ordinary continuation, isolated scenes do not deliver the owner’s expedition experience.
tests.renormalize: No fixed yield, stat, rate, variant count or percentage; numerical implementation readings are checks. Qualitative comparisons and causal use survive retuning.
tests.first_version: exactly one whole bar: complete land, life and the expedition signature

checks.what: Resolved settings/default/deserialization/reset and row/incident/recipe/offer availability census: every moved extra absent/ineligible at defaults in native and campaign supplying tiers; defs may stay loaded. Test each labelled next-version gate separately. T_SCOPE.

Regression values for shared elevation/weather/55 C zenith formula, roof/parasols at all angles, no biome heat/floor fields consumed, same geometry gives same direct component. Numbers are checks, never bars. T_SUN.

Resolved wildAnimals/wildPlants/allowedPackAnimals plus supplying defs/products/animalDensity, biological-role and actual caller manifest. Compare membership with entry roster, note multi-home without eviction; no every-field-as-bar demand.

Exact retained ordinary recipe/extraction/construction inputs, outputs, skills, provider egg/sac units and reservation/placement identity accounting as read from resolved defs. Deferred recipes/stills have gate checks and positive arms only in their tickets, not first-version production requirements. M_SUPPLY/T_SUPPLY.
Identity/ownership/depletion/status/reservation/pending-output trace before/reload/after; old-save extra state drain does not discard pawns or reset user values. M_STATES.

Same random stream and fixed physical eligibility with hydration/carried-water permutations and provider absent; inspect inputs for forbidden appraisal/proxy. Existing independent droid filter stays. Deferred event selector also retains exclusion before later enabling.

Coverage of geometry/footprint/bearing/roof/depth boundary classes and exact calibrated path/exposure reads. Preservation occupancy uses a live animal with Faction == null, BodySize >= 3 and Position in recorded caveCells, regardless of threat; check below/at/above the threshold. Existing synthetic cave/kernel fuzz rows are regression evidence only.

Actual source/track age, audio availability, timestamp and visible transition record; sound queue increment alone cannot pass perception. Rumble/motion-reach thresholds and update intervals are numeric checks.

Instrument records exact entry state/settings/fingerprints, uses disposable fixtures, never overwrites canonical saves, restores arbitrary values and identifies unmeasured/control-invalid runs instead of failing a bar. scene_observer becomes this check.

Load, clean log and superb working settings remain inherited floor. A red implementation/check is builder evidence to attribute and fix, not an additional bar or automatic refusal; see standing bar definition.

Whole run manifest: full map, all kept mechanics on, extras off, weather unlocked, normal actions/ticks and midway active-state save; original/reload/reordered histories, quantitative growth/stock/depth/error readings from M_SEASON.

Existing flight stat, real tracker state and directional whole-body animation wiring; no art-variant-count bar. No unattended induced/live flyer test or screenshots; unobserved visual flight remains owed to an owner-attended session.

rules.rule: delegated: retain existing largest suitable local outcrop shaping and optional tor fallback, real roofed connected chamber and finite cave placement; an unsuitable layout reports no cave truthfully. No planetary generation/seed sweep/repaint. Attack layout/fallback if cover or regional opportunities fail.
delegated: retained seep, guzzka, lens, cache and taken rows keep stable saved identity and finite contents; only actually consumed quantities leave the source, and reload/revisit never rerolls it.

delegated: physical current occupancy, accepted paths and shared geometry determine shelter, never quest denCleared. Independently of exploration or physical securing, a live giant-size unowned wild animal standing on any recorded cave cell suspends cave preservation, including a harmless grazer; taming/leaving/death is assessed from present state. A smaller actual threat makes the refuge unsecured without suspending preservation. This is not immunity from ordinary later attacks.

delegated: with preservation enabled, before and after exploration and independently of physical securing, claim only eligible rot-capable things actually on recorded roofed cave cells, not carried by pawns, and not already disabled by another owner, while no live giant-size unowned wild animal stands on any recorded cave cell, harmless grazers included. Smaller threats do not suspend preservation. Release exactly this claim on roof/position/qualifying-occupancy/toggle change and preserve its ownership through reload. Status names the cave effect; no global fresh aura or second titan owner.

delegated: All special solar apparatus and its jobs/production are deferred, default off. Keep the shared sun query loadable for existing callers; a deferred apparatus cannot become a first-version supply requirement through a recipe or UI dependency. Its later root-cell receiver choice remains attackable when that scope returns.

delegated: Ordinary collection, bills, hauling and use account for finite inputs and placed or explicitly pending products; blocked placement and worker interruption cannot destroy or duplicate the find. No direct proof helpers perform retained work. Still-specific feed conversion is off and tested only by its deferred ticket.

delegated: Ordinary edible eggs/sacs keep quantity data and ingestion independent of Debt, pour and comfort buffs. DBH may supply optional thirst integration, never a new DLC requirement or invented need. Solar still and brine dipping are default-off next-version work; without DBH their RM_StilledWater is non-ingestible carried/trade stock only, with no ordinary drink claimed. Shared later film never treats expiry as litres.

delegated: retain current patched roster membership and ordinary biological roles; no evictions and no fabricated new wild Karrask. Gaanok uses normal slow predation; siidda uses its actual stock dormancy. Scripted incidents are not required for ordinary life, actual flight remains a standing constraint.

delegated: use the shared swim eligibility plus active MovingDunes depth; genuinely hard ground forces appropriate surfacing, not harmlessness. No hydration/carried-water/appraisal ranking, even with no provider; retain independent physical eligibility/droid filtering. No new selection algorithm is designed here.

delegated: keep existing ordinary visual wake/breach/track and rumble/kill consequences as needed by concealed life. A lure/old trace is uncertainty, not exact identification. Committed baseline sand movement erases traces; a custom gale is not required. If sound is off, the visual danger sign remains.

delegated: ordinary dry weather and baseline dune transport stay unlocked; custom gale amplification/carry/renewal is off. Observe true shared weather sun factor; do not force Clear or stop retained mechanics to make another bar pass.

delegated: gate moved extras at every producer/consumer/offer/row/incident in both supplying tiers; keep code/defs. Decouple ordinary work, cave occupancy and water from them. Invalid legacy heat semantics are unreachable at every setting, not an optional mode.

delegated: identities, cave content depletion, owned rot/vanish flags, reservations and pending outputs persist or release through ordinary transitions. Existing extra actors/held pawns finish or recover visibly when off; never discard a pawn or another owner’s state to migrate. Ordinary corpse decay/butchery remains; HugeThings alone owns its titan sites and normal meat spoilage.

delegated: all major kept features have controls and truthful now/next-activation/local-furnishing labels, proposed defaults and all-off safety. Deferred controls explicitly say next version and default off; preserve exact prior user values after tests. No new cross-biome control. This is the standing floor implemented as choices/checks, not an extra passing bar.

delegated: use existing arrival/rock letter and inspect surfaces for truthful heat/roof, actual cave accessibility, current preservation and ordinary interrupted-work reasons. Remove obsolete low-sun, automatic-cooling, drip and active workshop claims; never advertise enabled effects of a parked feature.

meetings.why: Sparse planting, ordinary feeding/reproduction, salvage/weathering and settlement clearing can jointly erase open travel or leave dead life; pairwise agreement cannot settle their feedback.
meetings.model: M_SEASON: complete-map season and accumulated consequences

meetings.why: Roof/parasols, living casters, plant growth and heat query common geometry through cached consumers; old source has ruled-out branches. Shared policy and update agreement have not been measured. Deferred apparatus is not needed to pass shelter.
meetings.model: M_LAYOUT: cover and passage geometry sweep

meetings.why: Unrestricted ordinary wind/depth movement changes routes, signs and geometric exposure while organisms and workers consume resources and haul discoveries. Long-run interaction remains unmeasured; no special solar production is retained.
meetings.model: M_SEASON: complete-map season and accumulated consequences

meetings.why: A chamber may fit in a rock yet giant footprint/roof/drift and rest/storage needs together can invalidate its approach. Need the whole placement region, not one yardang.
meetings.model: M_LAYOUT: cover and passage geometry sweep

meetings.why: At proposal level these readers name distinct facts: exposure/ambient heat, cave occupancy/preservation, ordinary work access and uncertain movement. Truthful local messages can report them together without a safety guarantee, active workshop claim or species radar. R_GUIDANCE fixes stale prose; C_SIGN/T_SIGN still verify readability. A panel does not replace a physical sign.
Buried/striking/dead/departing actors, current den occupancy, shade changes and readable signs meet across transitions; no current transition coverage proves them together.
meetings.model: M_STATES: generated situations and ownership walks

meetings.why: Finite cave extraction, ordinary use/trade, scarce shared inputs and preservation release may lose or duplicate value under contention, or offer material with no actual buyer. The separate solar workshop and its fine-sand bootstrap are outside kept supply scope.
meetings.model: M_SUPPLY: practical provisioning and dependency economy

meetings.why: Ordinary death, cave-owned preservation, normal decay and HugeThings titan ownership can conflict across roof/holder/death/load boundaries. Moving conversion off removes one claimant but does not prove correct remaining restoration.
meetings.model: M_STATES: generated situations and ownership walks

meetings.why: No kept experience requires a deferred workshop producer: found cache food/steel/components can be used directly, eggs remain edible, ordinary catches remain usable, and grotto biosilica may be sold to an actual accepting buyer. Environmental seep brine is not a water reward. Furnace, lenses, oven, dipping and still now move together, so no unverified fine-sand trader replaces the sieve. Ordinary giants replace scripted visits, current occupancy replaces quest signals, and baseline wind replaces gale. Named gates and safe no-op data interfaces are ticketed; actual default-off absence still needs C_SCOPE, while ordinary supply usability remains unknown in its own M_SUPPLY meeting.
Reload during extraction/carry/roof loss/output blocking can combine depletion, reservations and rot ownership into loss or duplication even where each independent feature looks correct.
meetings.model: M_STATES: generated situations and ownership walks

scene_observer.why: An instrument cannot be a player-experience bar; retain assertions, controls and exact recovery as instrument obligations.

expedition_ocean.why: Re-derived from owner expedition/uncertain-discovery answers; split land from prepared shelter and actual practical use, then run complete. Full disposition: B_LAND, B_REFUGE, B_SUPPLY, B_WHOLE.

prepared_harbour.why: Owner makes preparation/current physical conditions the requirement; no quest or magic immunity.

practical_fortune.why: Owner practical provisioning/use retained; no numerical loot floor or mandatory upgrade.

direct_sun.why: Standing shared geometry retained; glare/goggle/cooling and mirage extras move with their separate tickets.

sand_signs.why: Keep readable natural concealed-life transitions; thumper, geophone and fishing job-start lure move, so code coupling does not retain tools. Full disposition: B_SIGNS, B_LIFE.

giant_encounters.as: T_LEVIATHAN, T_ERUPTION, T_BROOD, T_MIRROR_BEAM, T_HORN, T_DEN_QUEST, T_SARLACC_SEEP, T_SUN_LANCE
giant_encounters.why: Ordinary giants stay in B_LIFE; every scripted combat/quest/weapon route is an extra. Sun lance is parked with retirement recommended.

hydration_exclusion.why: Preserve recorded exclusion as selector rule and C_PREY check, not an invisible implementation bar. Readable predation remains B_LIFE/B_SIGNS.

gale_passage.why: Runner-up signature off for next version; ordinary weather/depth continues as land.

current_water.why: Ordinary edible egg/sac use stays as life/practical finds. This cleanse replaces blanket delegated current-water retention: solar recovery, dipping, poured response and religion all move; none is needed by the expedition signature. Full disposition: B_LIFE, B_SUPPLY; T_SOLAR_STILL, T_BRINE_DIPPING, T_POUR, T_WET_LINE, T_THUMPER, T_HOURBLOOM, T_WRINGING, T_COOLING_DRAUGHT.

debt_return.why: Faith accounting and ritual explicitly extras, even when upper-tier defs supply them.

giant_history.why: Scoped cave preservation stays; static bones are land; optional ordinary conversion/desiccation moves. Existing titan site/normal spoilage owner remains a dependency. Full disposition: B_PRESERVE, R_SAVE; T_CORPSE_HISTORY, T_GIANT_PRESERVATION.

ordinary_work.why: Retain ordinary collection, hauling, work and actual use/trade of finds; special solar manufacturing/cooking/recovery moves with its extras. Settings/log remain floor and numerical work readings remain checks. Full disposition: B_SUPPLY, B_WHOLE; C_SCOPE, C_WORK, C_FLOOR; T_SUN_TABLES, T_GLASS_MATERIALS, T_SOLAR_OVEN, T_SOLAR_STILL, T_BRINE_DIPPING.

stillsand_walk.why: Exactly one full-season whole bar adds unlocked full-system operation, active midway save/reload and second action order rather than a finished showcase.
